notes.title: Devlog #12 Animations and Menu Polishing Part 2
notes.content:
Starting of with Hector's little pets, usually rodents like mouses or rats are viewed as pests and at best, nuissances. However, for Hector, since he feels a sort of sympathy with them, they are usually great friends. Needless to say, Brumhilda isn't all that pleased about this, so Hector's little pets are usually keeping quiet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/2d03380e2445ac2607df3ea7d70884cc74b4558d.gif[/img]

However lazy Hector may be, he also has a creative mind, and sometimes, because of his creative genius, his drawings really come to life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/f6cffe03092a8bd9abcbc58baec63e396531384d.gif[/img]

Ever wondered what's behind the little mouse hole on the right? Well Hector has! But he's still not sure... He's convinced there's a whole new world hidden behind that small hole, and once in a while, mysterious creatures wander out...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/e07233ff7a2269dfba885fe58ccfb8ef074577fe.gif[/img]

If you're curious about how we draw, animate and polish our games, check out our Youtube channel! We have many educational videos and we also just started making game review videos!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/@Funtaptic/videos]Funtaptic Youtube[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #11 Animations and Menu Polishing Part 1
notes.content:
Today we'll be showcasing the work of our animators in the form of a couple short animations that, in our opinion, make the cave of the Grugs a lot more livelier. Alongside these, we will have a lot more movement on these screens in the form of clickable items such as doors, plants, ropes or other assets. Our first entry for today animations is Doug the invasive mole.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/8b55685f285e65cb5cc9e600176d70066a8a6724.gif[/img]

Doug always finds a way into other peoples homes, how he does isn't a mystery, on the other hand, why he does it is very much so. He is usually accompanied by Pod, the adventurous possum. This loud little possum lives out his life just like the Grugs, having adventures of his own! One such adventure is running from Brumhilda and making one helluva noise while doing so.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/7e51337c6e5d39c39c32d178301413a827b4274c.gif[/img]

Our last funky friend is Chirp, the little blue bird, who just wants to find a safe place to make a nest. However, she seems to make nests in the most unsual places. Chirp is friendly and nice to the Grugs, so she is welcome in their cave anytime, not that she feels safe around these loud cavemen and women!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/80100ccd965e9f01e5bbddf905dc0ffd470677c8.gif[/img]

Next week we'll continue on with more cute screen animations, so stay tuned, wishlist The Grugs: Origins to support our work and enjoy the spooky season!

notes.title: Devlog #10 Into the caves
notes.content:
Welcome to the deep dark caves of the stone age! These shadowy holes have been shifting and moving around for thousands of years, so you can never know what you'll find here. Sometimes, you'll stumble into larger caverns where you can find isolated beautiful landscapes, but you should keep your guard up, as even these beautiful halls have hidden dangers inside. Below you can see how our artists have worked to design such hall!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/f83d72bcffc66c284621b7a339193e13a214e06f.gif[/img]

Besides cool background art, our caves also have a number of unique assets you can interact with while spelunking! These are various rocks, boulders, crystals, roots, pathways, boulers, arches and many more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/52e39d057b115c50e6b9e9d4d8f65695793762a9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/4cae601c76ca7a1120805a47be6d3ec39d220f08.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/b88b624aed0cd0d0cdf2c7ef4441017f3155eaf4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/222b88d312f836bea9427bea88939837c04ccf2b.png[/img]

Alongside decorative and interactible assets, you may also find enemies and dangers inside these cave!
These require special attention to avoid or bypass, as the caves limit your vertical mobility, so jumping over them is especially difficult!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/9cf2a5b51ba9aa0544fd6320178c5e332bb37636.gif[/img]

We wish you a safe journey inside the caves, and hope to see you again on the surface, when we'll get to show you the second biome of the game, the lovely colored Autumn Hills! In the meantime, check out our Youtube channel and follow us on Twitter, as we have more content there as well!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/@Funtaptic]Funtaptic Youtube Channel[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/home]The Grugs Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #9 Character Skills
notes.content:
Starting with Hector, his specialty is, well, not too honorable, but very useful! Living with Brumhilda has thought him how to get up to speed really quickly, so he has developed his very own special evasive dash to get out of trouble! However, this leaves Hector exhausted for a while, being slowed and unable to dash again for a while. While in this sorry state, Hector usually resorts to blind luck, which works 100% of the time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/237eeb68b7d4b06ddabbd2630c7d8ddfdaf4f762.gif[/img]
If Hector personifies the flight, in fight or flight, then you know what Brumhilda stands for. Her signature skill, the earthshattering stomp breaks everything known to caveman in front of her, whether it be a spiky bush a rocky boulder or a ferocious dino! She's also a skilled cook, being able to create heal herself on the move! Here's an early look into how Brumhilda's stomp will look in game:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/09f26fac7dd9cbd00cef4555bf48f507d72959c9.gif[/img]
If you can't run from it or break it, just outsmart it! Brat's signature skill revolves around hiding from enemies and outmanuevering them with an extra jump! However, he is the shortest and weakest of the family, so without his wits and quick feet, he is in big trouble!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/e77e67d280447a991c85a58e7057c4ea5ee924e4.gif[/img]
When all else fails, just charge into battle with the ultimate companion, Pip! When Lola faces a challenge, she works together with her best friend and pet, Pip, either blowing a bubble, which protects her from an immediate danger, or just trampling any bushes or obstacles which could impede them on their journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/38762ef8265b0a603857255720c0b3426bfc0e65.gif[/img]

Every map has it's own challenges, so bring the right character, or test different playstyles out! For more Grugs content, check out our Youtube channel at:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2lLe2dzh1qtYVouda_yBVg]Grugs Youtube[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #8 Introducing Lola & Pip
notes.content:
Most parents know about the differences between the first and second child, well, in the case of Lola, she's definitely the typical second child. Not only did she inherit Brumhilda's strenght, but she's close to surpassing it. She's also extremely loveable, being the perfect, cute and orderly child, she can get away with practically anything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/651dad944c08df277d6ae47c7ad8cf6529a34346.png[/img]

As perfect as she is, she couldn't manage it alone. That's where Pip, her loyal pet in the form of a baby mammoth comes in. He's always there to support her, and sees her as a best friend. How they came to be best friends, noone really knows, except for Brat, who somehow seems really dissapointed about it all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/40ad5a5b6988a170392928d6f63e0e38786cab33.gif[/img]

With Lola's strenght and Pip's speed and loyalty, they just couldn't sit still and had to let loose their curious mind and adventurer spirit. So they ventured into the Misty Jungle where they thought they might find some hidden treasure or a source of food. Instead, what they found was more than they could bargain for...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/dadea48c1965e18cabcb3e5796972fb27f93dab8.gif[/img]

Lola also appears briefy in Hector's Rest Quest, and she's also a playable character in The Grugs Arena: Jungle Brawl! If you want to see more Grugs related content, check out our Youtube channel as we post gameplay showcases and animated videos there:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/@Funtaptic]Funtaptic Youtube[/url]

We're also active on a daily basis on Twitter, if you wanna read about our game developer journey, feel free to give us a follow there as well:

[url=https://twitter.com/funtaptic]Funtaptic Twitter[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/TheGrugsGames]The Grugs Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #7 Ui and screen design
notes.content:
Welcome, welcome! It's a bit dusty, that's because Brumhilda has been locked away due to her anger issues, but other than that, welcome to the cozy cave of The Grugs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/6c3fd163ea39b365d8a3412fad0ea32fa2fd369b.gif[/img]

Here in the luxurious main hall, you can find the couch where the family usually hangs out, lucky for them, nothing can get under it. You can also find the achievements, setting and play buttons! From here, you can find each family members special little room, starting on the left with Hector!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/2aa60dc818497b6edf70b0a2ee53a7c74a53b80f.gif[/img]

These rooms not only provide respite from the wilderness outside, but also allow each family member to express their quirky personality to the full! Though as you can see, only Hector's room is open for visitors, maybe you can do something about that...

You can also decorate each room to make the family feel at home, look at the special traits and skills of each character here, selec who you wanna play as, and finally, even customize them in various different clothes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/00d2c6504c01fccedf85c67e62d71d79199513af.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for next weeks devlog where we'll be introducing the last playable character of the game!

notes.title: Devlog #6 Introducing Brat
notes.content:
You've already seen Brumhilda and Hector, now meet their first child: Brat, the mischievous genius! 

When it comes to the personality of Brat, we wanted to show that strenght isn't the only solution to stone age problems, sometimes you gotta use your brains a bit as well. Well, Brat ceratinaly does that a lot, as the first child, he inherited the creativity and free spirit of Hector, and the persistance and work ethic of Brumhilda. Because of this, Brat is known for attention to detail, and his many inventions! Even his room's door is a special one, using some sort of advanced technology to open and close, while Hector and Brumhilda use the old fashioned doors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/d38b85d086ca17cad6aafe1443bc4b21ebae5b38.gif[/img]

An inventor has to be precise and attentive, and so another trait that Brat boast is six times the attention span of his dad, which by Hector's standards is not impressive at all. He is also extremely quick on the foot, and though he can't jump far, at least he can jump a lot! Both of these traits come in handy in his biome, the Icy Peaks! 

Brat might seem like the perfect child, but to the Grugs, he's quite the opposite. One disadvantage of being smart in the stone is, well, not being understood. In turn, Brat is often seen as a problem child, constantly breaking things, not following orders, and in general, always finding trouble, even where there is none. His sister, Lola sees him as the most evil creature known to cavemankind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/8c6407f42e6ab2f9a390de9d15e8c9d17fdb85ab.gif[/img]

Brat also has quite a few costumes too, each with unique sounds, animations and effects. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/e036cf1727d3bf78a9e1a18ee3308cd8e25a863d.gif[/img]

We feel like the design of Brat fits those players who like to move fast and in creative ways, testing the limits of the game, if you're a player like that, we're sure you'll enjoy playing as Brat, the mischievous genius!

notes.title: Devlog #5 Map and biomes
notes.content:
Welcome to our fifth developer log, this time we'll be showing you guys more of the world you'll get to explore as the four members of The Grugs family!

As we mentioned previously, the world of the Grugs includes multiple different biomes, each with their own colour scheme, reoccuring motives, design elements, enemies and challenges and a unique boss at the end! The first of biome is the lovely, lush green hills. This place is dominated by greenery, tall grass, reeds, bushes, trees and many other organic features. This is due to the abundant fresh water that flows from the nearest mountaintop. Needless to say, the Grugs family was smart to build their home here, as it's a relatively peaceful and a safe area, however, occasionally raptors and pterodactyls do find their way into here, as there's plenty of food for them to find, make sure you don't become it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/08d482f04bdac6785c033461492a52887f0325d6.gif[/img]

The first four levels lead you from the home cave towards the source of the fresh waters, this shall prepare you for the challenges up ahead. The next levels take you towards the borders of the green hills, to the great lookout tree. From this tree, you can already see the next biome you'll be able to explore, but before you do so, there's a mysterious egg on the tree!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/9999e7309146aa7ea8a2e3cca803dcacfad2160f.gif[/img]

The Green Hills are Hector's favorite playground, as he grew up here and knows it like the palm of his hands. He's familiar with all of the dangers of this land, whether it be spikes, boulders, the flowing waters of the mountains or the stagnant pools of the swamps. What he's not familiar with is the occasional hungry dino that wanders into his homelands, but he can use the giant mushrooms that grow here to bounce away from them! If you're curious about how the green hills will look like in game, check out our third devlog, in which we show you how the art of the world has been developing.

Stay tuned for next weeks devlog, where we'll introduce you to the third playable character, Brat, the mischievous genius. Until then, enjoy this special look into how the map will potentially look like in game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/389bbba173c3305288417b2aff92f91ef671fbb9.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #4 Introducing Brumhilda
notes.content:
Welcome to our fourth developer log, here, we'll introduce our second playable character, Brumhilda, the wife and mother of the family.

When it came to desgining Brumhilda, we wanted to create a mother figure that was different from most of the archetypical caring, soft and nurturing characters we've seen so many times, but we also didn't want to stray too far from the already well-known image of a mother, and so the first concept for the giant wooden spoon wielding brunnette with bangs was born. Her shape design tells the most about her character, as it includes mostly squared shapes, but she also has a few sharp edges around her dress and hair. This makes her feel like a inherently soft character with a hard exterior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/015dbb77d497beec108fa77a9b18a71f37f166ce.gif[/img]

Brumhilda's animations all have lots of weight to them, yet they also have a small sense of grace too. We did this to convey not only her size and power, but also her hidden feminine side, which was shown briefly in the first promotional trailer for The Grugs: Origins. 

[previewyoutube=I7IV3Y4cUhU;full][/previewyoutube]

When it comes to giving her a voice, we're lucky to have people in our team who have a great many . One such person is responsible for not only many of the backend programing but also for a lot of the voices you get to hear in our games. He's the voice of both Hector and Brumhilda, and we're proud to have someone with such a broad list of talents.

[previewyoutube=d5yNsz8XFlk;full][/previewyoutube]

Besides the bruttish figure, Brumhilda also has a soft side to her character, however scary her children and husband may take her, at the end of the day, she has their best interestest at heart. And besides keeping her family well fed and alive, she's also a great dancer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/8b168799f2ff9ccd087d772cd16e2ffed4d15627.gif[/img]

Just as with Hector, Brumhilda also has a large wardrobe full of costumes to try on for a variety of occasions, whether it be something formal, festive or just straight up unconventional!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/b1e1ac18935f87d49f8981c71d2f9e96644f6e4c.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #3 Visuals design
notes.content:
Welcome to our third developer log, this week we'll be showcasing the wonderful work of our lead art designer focusing on world building, environment and atmosphere.

Firstly, we thought it necessary to showcase the artworks first designed years ago for the mobile version, since these assets mark the start of the unique and colourful style of art we have continued to expand and evolve all the way into today. However, when we started working on The Grugs: Origins, we no longer had the performance and size limitations that mobile platforms have, and because of this we did our best to improve on each and every visual element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/a7b3daa523c7b65bbe97c6d2abfc6ec210416ba4.gif[/img]

Secondly, the games that inspired us to bring The Grugs to PC are known for their incredible visual perspective, with each scene having an immense depht to it. We wish to replicate this with multiple foreground and background layers, to essentially make the world feel more 3D, even though practically its a 2D platformer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/86a8093230d97bac3c5baa6c19cb1e12e3ee0160.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/99798a8b208c41b04a2dbf55cfcedd32179d39a3.gif[/img]

Another thing we wanted to include was a reoccuring motive in every biome, for the first one the spiral like shape that can be seen on checkpoint stones, rocks, trees, bushes, and many other assets. We believe that when it comes to visual clarity and giving the player a sense of belonging, reoccuring shapes and images help sell the idea that the game world is a familiar, life-like place, which helps create an immersive world.

We will be giving further looks into how the visuals of the game are developing in the following weeks, focusing on the design of caves and other interior elements, and designs for the other biomes as well, we also have more content to show regarding the other members of the family, enemies and even bosses, so stay tuned!

If you wanna see our artists work live, here's a small showcase of their work process:
[url=https://youtu.be/YTsjQEK_D4c]Animating a scene in 4 steps[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #2 Introducing Hector
notes.content:
Welcome to our second developer log, where we introduce our first playable character, him being Hector, the head of The Grugs, the man of the cave, however lazy he may be.

Our early designs for Hector started with the idea of an unconventional caveman, who is not the typical strong and dumb brute, but someone full of creative ideas and just a mind of his own. Throw this character into a family setting, and soon he'll be tired of all of the responsabilties and troubles of a serious life. In terms of looks, we went with a heavily stylized, floating hands look, but we wanted to have a clear siluette for the character, and so the hair and the beard made that possible. Below you can find an artwork for Hector we used in a promotional video. While in a side view his facial expressions are mostly hidden, make no mistake, Hector has become one of our most expressive characters when it comes to sounds, movements and facial mimicry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/59f7449dff17be672a38454a918b19d2868c1a8c.gif[/img]

When it came to animating Hector, we focused on making his movements solid and strong, yet quirky and erratic at the same time. In our experience, the animations and movements of a character tell the most about them, and so out of all of our characters, Hector has the most animated movements and interactions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/3c200ab5f2507912354ecf95f6fd59ecb6d96dcc.gif[/img]
Another important part of a character is how the player can customize them, looking at Hector, he has a variety of unlockable skins for character expression: from pirates and vikings, to monsters and wizards, Hector has a lot of costumes to choose from!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/8f11e9817aa879dfb63638924731e91a7ada00ce.gif[/img]


While at first, Hector might seem like he's truly just a simple guy, he has a lot of depth as well. He's the artist of the family, being responsible for many of the cave paintings in The Grugs games. He's also the wielder of the first tool of man, the almighty club, with which he can smash anything that comes his way, provided he's brave enough to do so!

For those among you who want to know more about Hector, he also has an entire mobile game dedicated to his adventures, which you can check out below:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FBskbcvTxCc]Hector's Rest Quest Trailer[/url]
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=funtaptic.thegrugs.runner.hector&hl=en&gl=US]Hector's Rest Quest on Google Play[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/940f1593c2b02599986af7116799141d10ebe546.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #1 First look into The Grugs: Origins
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In this announcement, we will be giving special insights into how The Grugs: Origins started out as an idea and how it's development has been going!

The first idea for The Grugs games started off around the end 2020, but back then we focused on mobile platforms such as Google Play and the Apple Appstore. Taking the game to PC, and making PC games in general has been a great aspiration for everyone on our team so taking our previous ideas and making them PC worthy is what we set out to do. The following image is one of the first splash arts we designed for the game, in it you can see the main members of the family: Hector, in the middle, the laziest man alive, Brumhilda, his wife on the right, the best jam cook, and Lola and Brat in order on the left, the strongest girl and the craftiest boy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/81aa520999330a45587216e60d82a1d1c2c24382.png[/img]

Our first sketches for The Grugs: Origins started with a design for a unique and stylish stone-age world, centered around the first family of cavemen, them being, The Grugs. Their home and a sort of leader, Hector is visible on the image provided. The idea for the prehistoric setting came from the appropriately named Prehistorik, which is a retro platformer, while the gameplay and movement mechanics were inspired by Geometry Dash. Just below this paragraph, you can see the how the old mobile game looked, and the first design variant for The Grugs: Origins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/a6f22d11ad7b4987b2f004cf804418631fa2e595.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/24de753504d564b8f5cf2e8a38516eb8b30afc71.jpg[/img]

As platformers, as a genre have been around for over decades, it's important to try to experiement with diferent design ideas to keep the gameplay fresh, as such, we decided on having 4 playable characters, each with different skills and specalities, strenghts and weaknesses for different playstyles and for player expression and flexibility when it comes to the challenges faced ingame. We'd also like to add unique skins with different sounds, animations and effects to each of the characters as a method for character customization. Speaking of character customization, the following images are comparrison of the mobile version for the character customization screen, and the same for the PC version, however, in the PC version, there will a separate room for each of the characters, as there will much more in terms of character customization than just skins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/695e4184baa5739ac3b6b6a19aa86a5d5c0ce229.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476066/d2aa155e512f76973263ae43fc012a310fec3c0e.jpg[/img]

In the future we'll be giving more information regarding the design process and smaller developer logs too for more specific features. We hope you're as excited about Grugs: Origins as we are, and we hope you'll follow our journey and get to enjoy our game when it is finished.

Stay tuned for more, untill then, here's the the trailer we created for the original The Grugs mobile game: (Expect even better quality for the PC trailer!)
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-kq9bpD2DMc]The Grugs: Family Story Trailer[/url]

notes.title: The Grugs comes to Steam!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are happy to announce that we are working on Grugs: Origins, which will be a PC port of The Grugs mobile games. We understand just how difficult it is to take a mobile game and make it into an enjoyable and exciting PC game, but we certainly would like to try. So if you're interested, wishlist our game and follow us on our game development journey!
